ei.title: 기술적 실업이 사회 질서에 미치는 위험

fullPassage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and a source of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfilment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.

questions.passage: A serious (A)[deterioration / improvement] in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of (B)[inequality / equality] in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and a source of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of (C)[fulfilment / frustration] that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 악화(deterioration), 불평등(inequality), 성취감(fulfilment)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① deterioration — inequality — fulfilment: 근로 생활의 '악화'가 사회 질서를 교란하고, 기술적 실업이 '불평등'을 심화시키며, 직업에서 느끼는 '성취감'이 사라질 위협.
❌ ② improvement — inequality — fulfilment: (A) '개선'이면 사회 질서에 교란이 아님.
❌ ③ deterioration — equality — fulfilment: (B) '평등'이면 극단적 버전이라는 맥락에 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ deterioration — inequality — frustration: (C) 직업에서 '좌절'을 느끼기에 운이 좋다는 것은 비논리적.
det.tip: deterioration(악화) ↔ improvement(개선), inequality(불평등) ↔ equality(평등), fulfilment(성취감) ↔ frustration(좌절)

questions.passage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply (A)[disturbing / reassuring] to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would (B)[weaken / strengthen] that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and a source of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a (C)[reliable / unreliable] income, but that this sense of fulfilment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 불안하게 하는(disturbing), 약화시키다(weaken), 안정적인(reliable)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ disturbing — weaken — reliable: 근로 생활 악화가 사회 질서에 '불안'을 주고, 기술적 실업이 오랜 체제를 '약화'시키며, '안정적인' 소득을 찾을 수 없게 됨.
❌ ① reassuring — weaken — reliable: (A) '안심시키는'이면 뒤의 dangerous와 모순.
❌ ② disturbing — strengthen — reliable: (B) '강화'하면 극단적 불평등을 조장한다는 맥락에 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ disturbing — weaken — unreliable: (C) 찾을 수 없는 것이 '불안정한' 소득이면 논리 모순 — unable to find unreliable income은 좋은 일.

questions.passage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that (A)[longstanding / temporary] arrangement, encouraging an even more (B)[extreme / moderate] version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and a source of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfilment that some people are (C)[fortunate / reluctant] to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 오래된(longstanding), 극단적인(extreme), 운이 좋은(fortunate)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② longstanding — extreme — fortunate: '오래된' 체제가 약화되고, '극단적인' 불평등이 조장되며, 성취감을 느끼기에 '운이 좋은' 사람들.
❌ ① temporary — extreme — fortunate: (A) '일시적'이면 약화의 의미가 약해짐.
❌ ③ longstanding — moderate — fortunate: (B) '온건한' 불평등이면 even more extreme이라는 수식어와 모순.
❌ ④ longstanding — extreme — reluctant: (C) '꺼리는'이면 성취감을 느끼려 하지 않는다는 뜻으로 부적절.

questions.passage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would ①<u>weaken</u> that longstanding arrangement, ②<u>encouraging</u> an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and a source of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a ③<u>reliable</u> income, but that this sense of fulfilment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a ④<u>disappointing</u> life.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ disappointing → satisfying: 목적을 찾고 '실망스러운' 삶이 아니라 '만족스러운' 삶을 살 수 없게 된다는 맥락입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① weaken: 기술적 실업이 오래된 체제를 '약화시킨다'는 문맥 적절.
✅ ② encouraging: 불평등의 극단적 형태를 '조장한다'는 문맥 적절.
✅ ③ reliable: '안정적인' 소득을 찾을 수 없다는 문맥 적절.
❌ ④ disappointing → satisfying: 성취감이 사라져 '만족스러운' 삶을 살 수 없다는 맥락. '실망스러운'은 반의어. ← 정답

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ narrower → broader: 위협이 '좁아지는' 것이 아니라 '더 넓어진다'는 맥락입니다.

✅ ④ satisfying: '만족스러운' 삶을 살 수 없다는 문맥 적절.

det.analysis:
✅ ① consequences: 기술 변화의 '결과'가 위험하다는 문맥 적절.

✅ ③ meaning: 일이 소득과 '의미'의 원천이라는 문맥 적절.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 fruits이 (A)에서 사용된 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: (A)에서 fruits = 결실, 성과 / (B)에서 fruits = 과일
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 결실, 성과: (A)에서 'fruits of growth'는 성장의 '결실/성과'라는 비유적 의미.
❌ ① 과일, 열매: (B)의 의미로 식물의 과일.
❌ ② 수확물, 농산물: 구체적 수확물이지만 (A)의 추상적 의미와 다름.
❌ ④ 씨앗, 원인: fruits와 무관한 의미.
det.tip: fruits of growth/labor = 성장/노동의 결실, 성과 (비유적 표현)

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a gradual decline in quality, condition, or strength"

det.korean: 질, 상태, 또는 힘의 점진적 쇠퇴 = deterioration (악화)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ deterioration: '악화'는 점진적 쇠퇴라는 정의에 정확히 부합.
❌ ① arrangement: '배치, 체제'는 쇠퇴와 무관.
❌ ② disturbance: '교란'은 방해를 의미하지 점진적 쇠퇴가 아님.
❌ ③ unemployment: '실업'은 일자리 상실이지 점진적 쇠퇴가 아님.

questions.passage: Technological __________ would weaken that longstanding arrangement. Many workers could lose their jobs. (employ)
questions.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: employ → unemployment: 형용사 Technological 뒤에 명사가 필요하고, 문맥상 기술적 '실업'이라는 부정 명사가 적절합니다.
det.analysis: Technological 뒤에 명사 필요. employ(고용하다) → employment(고용) → unemployment(실업). 문맥상 일자리를 잃는다는 내용이므로 un- 접두사 → unemployment.

questions.passage: The __________ between rich and poor has been growing. Some receive a lot while others receive nothing at all. (equal)
questions.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: equal → inequality: 관사 The 뒤에 명사가 필요하고, 문맥상 부자와 가난한 사이의 '불평등'이 커지고 있다는 의미입니다.
det.analysis: The 뒤에 명사 필요. equal(동등한) → equality(평등) → inequality(불평등). 문맥상 some receive a lot, others nothing이므로 불평등.

questions.passage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is __________. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfilment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: both a source of income and a source of meaning (소득의 원천이자 의미의 원천): 일이 경제적 기능과 의미적 기능 둘 다 한다는 핵심 주장.
det.analysis:
✅ ① both a source of income and a source of meaning: 교란이 경제적(economic)인 것만이 아니라는 앞 문장의 단서에서, 일이 소득과 의미 '둘 다'의 원천이라는 논리.
❌ ② deeply disturbing to the social order: 일 자체가 '사회 질서에 불안'이라는 것은 앞 문장과 혼동 유발이지만, 빈칸의 주어는 work임.
❌ ③ a longstanding source of inequality: '오래된 불평등의 원천'은 본문 논조와 반대 — 일은 불평등을 만드는 것이 아님.
❌ ④ hollowed out by technological change: '기술 변화에 의해 공동화된'은 뒤에서 노동 시장에 대한 설명이지 work 자체가 아님.
det.tip: both A and B (A와 B 둘 다) — 일의 이중 기능: 소득 + 의미

ch: both a source of income and a source of meaning
deeply disturbing to the social order

questions.passage: A serious deterioration in people's working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we __________; for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all. Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and a source of meaning. And with that in mind, the threat is even broader — not only that the labor market might be hollowed out, leaving some unable to find a good job and a reliable income, but that this sense of fulfilment that some people are fortunate to feel in their jobs might be hollowed out as well, leaving them unable to find purpose and live a satisfying life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: share out the fruits of growth (성장의 과실을 나눈다): 일의 세계가 성장의 혜택을 분배하는 주요 방법이라는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ share out the fruits of growth: 일의 세계가 성장의 '과실을 나누는' 주요 방법이며, 뒤에서 소득을 받는 논의로 자연스럽게 연결.
❌ ① weaken that longstanding arrangement: '오래된 체제를 약화시킨다'는 실업의 효과이지 일의 역할이 아님.
❌ ② find a reliable income: '안정적 소득을 찾는다'는 뒤에서 나오는 개인 목표이지 일의 세계의 역할이 아님.
❌ ④ receive nothing at all: '아무것도 받지 못한다'는 불평등의 결과이지 일의 기능이 아님.
det.tip: share out the fruits of growth = 성장의 과실을 나누다/분배하다

ch: share out the fruits of growth
